title: Writing The Physics of Angels with Matthew Fox
summary: Rupert Sheldrake tells of Writing The Physics of Angels with Matthew Fox, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we chose the most interesting passages in in their books about angels the most relevant ones and then we discussed each short passage as a dialogue and that's what the book is really

plain: A biologist known for unusual ideas, Rupert Sheldrake, says he wrote a book called The Physics of Angels together with a writer named Matthew Fox. He says they chose the most interesting passages about angels from old Christian writers such as Dionysius the Areopagite, Thomas Aquinas and Hildegard of Bingen, then discussed each short passage as a dialogue. He tells it to explain how the book brings old ideas about angels into talk with modern science.
